translation: Ginseng (人參, three qian), clove (丁香, one liang), acanthopanax (五加皮, two liang), licorice (甘草, eight qian), poria (茯苓, two qian), Chinese angelica (當歸, washed in wine, one liang), dragon's blood (血竭, one liang), drynaria (骨碎補, one liang), schisandra (五味子, one liang), myrrh (沒藥, de-oiled, two liang). Grind all together into a fine powder, refine honey into pills, take three qian each time, dissolved in light yellow wine morning and evening; it may also be dissolved in boy's urine (童便).
